newsitem.title: FRANCE: French right ahead in latest CSA opinion poll.
newsitem.headline: French right ahead in latest CSA opinion poll.

text.p: Following are the results of an opinion poll of voters' intentions ahead of the May 25/June 1 two-round parliamentary election.
The poll of 1,012 representative adults registered to vote was conducted by CSA on May 16 and 17 for radio stations France Inter and France Info as well as for France 3 television.
It was made public on Saturday.
(* CSA gives no separate figure for Ecologists. They are included in the total for Socialists and other left).

CSA said the projection of seats should be treated with caution, noting voters would be influenced in the June 1 run-off by the results of the first round, the list of candidates for the second round and campaigning between the two ballots.
The seat projections are for metropolitan France only.
